payload.title: Lemma 2.22 (forward difference comparison)
payload.milestone_description:
For continuous $f:[a,b]\to\mathbb R$ and $C^1$ $\psi:[a,b]\times\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, if $D^+f(t)\le\psi(t,f(t))$ for $t\in[a,b)$, every solution on $[a,b]$ of $G'=\psi(t,G)$ with $f(a)\le G(a)$ satisfies $f\le G$ throughout $[a,b]$. Here $D^+$ denotes the upper right Dini derivative.

[Source: Morgan-Tian, p. 33](https://www.claymath.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Ricci-pdf.pdf#page=76).

milestones.link_status: Awaiting a faithful platform formalization; no theorem is attested by this plan.

payload.title: Proposition 15.3 (topological effect of surgery)
payload.milestone_description:
For a generalized Ricci flow satisfying Assumptions (1)-(7), any singular time $t$ and sufficiently close $t'<t$, $M_{t'}$ is diffeomorphic to connected sums among components of the disjoint union of $M_t$, finitely many $S^2$-bundles over $S^1$, and finitely many closed constant-positive-curvature three-manifolds.

[Source: Morgan-Tian, p. 357](https://www.claymath.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Ricci-pdf.pdf#page=400).

milestones.link_status: Awaiting a faithful platform formalization; no theorem is attested by this plan.

payload.title: Theorem 18.1 (finite-time extinction)
payload.milestone_description:
A compact connected normalized Riemannian three-manifold whose fundamental group is a free product of finite and infinite cyclic groups contains no embedded $\mathbb{RP}^2$ with trivial normal bundle. Its Theorem 15.9 surgery flow has empty slices for all sufficiently large times.

[Source: Morgan-Tian, p. 415](https://www.claymath.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Ricci-pdf.pdf#page=458).

milestones.link_status: Awaiting a faithful platform formalization; no theorem is attested by this plan.

payload.title: Corollary 15.4(1) (topology from extinction)
payload.milestone_description:
For a generalized Ricci flow satisfying Assumptions (1)-(7) with initial manifold $M$, if $M_T=\varnothing$ for some $T>0$, then $M$ is diffeomorphic to a connected sum of $S^2$-bundles over $S^1$ and three-dimensional spherical space forms.

[Source: Morgan-Tian, p. 358](https://www.claymath.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Ricci-pdf.pdf#page=401).

after.title: All-time Ricci flow with surgery
after.milestone_description:
Every closed oriented Riemannian three-manifold with normalized metric admits a Ricci flow with $(r,\delta)$-cutoff for all $t\ge0$, for suitable positive nonincreasing parameters $r,\delta$, allowing empty slices.

[Source: Kleiner-Lott, Proposition 77.2, p. 146 (existence consequence)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0605667v5#page=146).

after.title: Topological effect of surgery
after.milestone_description:
At a Kleiner-Lott cutoff surgery, recover the presurgery manifold up to diffeomorphism by finitely many operations: join two components by connected sum; sum a component with $S^1\times S^2$ or $\mathbb{RP}^3$; adjoin a component $S^1\times S^2$ or a spherical space form.

[Source: Kleiner-Lott, Lemma 73.4, p. 140](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0605667v5#page=140).

after.title: Finite-time extinction
after.milestone_description:
Every Kleiner-Lott Ricci flow with surgery starting from a closed simply connected Riemannian three-manifold satisfies $M_t=\varnothing$ for all sufficiently large $t$.

[Source: Kleiner-Lott, Claim 3.5, p. 9](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0605667v5#page=9). Kleiner-Lott cite [Perelman](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0307245) and [Colding-Minicozzi](https://arxiv.org/abs/0707.0108) for this input.

after.title: Topology from extinction
after.milestone_description:
If a Kleiner-Lott Ricci flow with surgery on a closed connected orientable three-manifold $M$ becomes extinct, then $M$ is diffeomorphic to a connected sum of $S^1\times S^2$ factors and spherical space forms.

[Source: Kleiner-Lott, Lemma 81.2, p. 160](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0605667v5#page=160).
